messages.author: 6172ba5a43c33a66
messages.subject: interaction and 3D
parts:
I have two things to ask:

1. I've plot a scatter plot. I want to achieve the function that when
the mouse located at every point, the coordinate can show left bottom
side.

2. I read from official ggplot doc, it says "ggplot does not support
true 3D plot". Does it mean there are some simulate ways to achieve 3D
plot? If so, how?

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: interaction and 3D
parts:
1. You want to use something other than ggplot, and probably (I think)
something other than R, although see "?locator".
2. ggplot will plot 2d surfaces with a third dimension as color or
contours. For a true 3d plot, take a look at the lattice or
scatterplot3d packages. There are probably others I don't know about.

Ben
